measurement_metric: cycle_averaged_x_bar = mean(x_t over final C steps)
verdict_explanation: Boundary disappears at large C (unconditional failure): two-regime finding. (i) Small-C regime (C=10): Mixed behavior (survives for beta2 >= 0.8, fails at beta2=0.5 with x_bar=+0.807). (ii) Intermediate-C regime (C=30): unique bracket at k*=0.300, beta2*=0.990. (iii) Large-C regime (C>=100): boundary ceases to exist - Adam fails unconditionally across all probed beta2 in [0.05, 1-1e-6].

10.note: Survives at high beta2 (>=0.8), fails at beta2=0.5 (x_bar=+0.807)

probe_P1_beta2_independence.finding: At C=100, cycle_mean is constant at +0.173 for beta2 in [0.99, 1-1e-6] (tau2 = 100 to 1e6). Second-moment memory horizon is detached from divergence threshold.

probe_P2_alpha_threshold.finding: At C=100, beta2=0.999: survival at alpha in [0.26, 0.45] (cycle_mean < 0), failure above and below. Traverse threshold alpha* = 0.251 matches prediction 2*sqrt(C)/(C - s*) = 0.263 within 5%. At beta2=0.9 (v-collapse regime): fails at all alpha including 0.10.

probe_P3_single_cycle_trace.finding: Post-burst, m_tilde starts at +(1-beta1)*C = 10 and crosses zero at s* ~ tau1*ln((1-beta1)*C+1) ~ 24 steps. Protected window: steps 1-24 retract toward -1. Steps 25-100 accumulate positive drift. Dwell fraction = 0.50 (full-interval sweep, not pinning at +1).

regret_exponents_lambda_constant_alpha.caveat: All three optimizers use constant alpha=0.8, which violates the decreasing step-size conditions of all three regret theorems. Apparent lambda > 1 values are finite-window offset artifacts; asymptotic regret is mathematically bounded by O(T).
